test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 2: Student Registers and is Enrolled
test_cases.pre_condition: A student user is successfully logged in and has been enrolled in a course, currently viewing the Course Details Page.
test_cases.expected_result: The student's session is terminated, and they are redirected to the Landing Page. All temporary authentication data is cleared, and the system notifies the user of successful logout.
test_cases.post_condition: The student user is logged out of the system and is on the Landing Page, ready for a new login or registration.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Logout' button in the navigation bar.
